data.description:
## Goal

The herdr downtime worker dispatches at most ONE audit per idle dispatch window (active-audit single-flight, WL-0MT3PHW4I002SNOV) and each window requires a continuous LLM idle period (>=60s with >=2 free slots, DOWNTIME_AUDIT_MIN_FREE_SLOTS=2). Under sustained agent traffic, windows are rare, so the audit tier's per-window throughput (audit skill batch drain, AUDIT_BATCH_MAX_ITEMS=5 per window) is the hard ceiling on draining the completed/in_review backlog. The audit skill's batch drain already processes multiple QUEUED items after the first dispatch, but herdr can only seed that batch with ONE dispatch per window and does not adapt its window cadence to backlog depth.

## Acceptance criteria

1. **AC1 - Depth-aware audit dispatch**: when the audit-eligible backlog (completed/in_review items without a fresh audit, per the existing staleness/recency windows) exceeds a configured threshold (e.g. QUEUE_DEPTH_BATCH_THRESHOLD), the audit tier considers dispatching MORE than one audit target per window (subject to the same idle gate, free-slot minimums and active-audit single-flight), so a deep queue drains faster within a window.
2. **AC2 - Interactive safety preserved**: no dispatch ever occurs without the existing idle-duration gate and DOWNTIME_AUDIT_MIN_FREE_SLOTS=2; the relaxed depth-aware path only raises the per-window COUNT, never the gate strictness.
3. **AC3 - No duplicate dispatch**: the existing dispatched-marker exclusion and active-audit single-flight continue to hold per item; the depth-aware path launches distinct items only.
4. **AC4 - Test coverage**: herdr unit tests assert (a) single-dispatch behaviour at shallow depth is unchanged, (b) N>1 audit dispatches when depth>=threshold, (c) the idle gate still blocks all dispatch when undersatisfied.
5. **AC5 - Full herdr test suite passes** with the change.

## Constraints

- Keep the strict idle gate for interactive protection (reserve >=1 local slot); only the per-window audit COUNT may adapt to backlog depth.
- Must not destabilize leader election/lease (5-min TTL), check-ins, pruning, fail-closed lookups, or the coordination offer path.
- The audit skill's own batch drain (AUDIT_BATCH_* in SorraAgents) remains the mechanism that processes many queued items after a dispatch; herdr only seeds the window.

## Related work

- WL-0MT3PHW4I002SNOV - active-audit single-flight (the constraint this item relaxes per-window, not per-item)
- WL-0MST3OJ8S0001ROL - downtime dispatcher leader election
- WL-0MT32F90V008UAD2 - idle-gate slot requirements (AC3)
- SA-0MTG5TP5Z008QBL5 (SorraAgents) - audit batch drain mode that consumes the seeded window
data.title: Herdr audit dispatch: deepen per-window batch when the in_review queue is deep
